idea-plugin.name: Monorepo Git Status
idea-plugin.description:
Monorepo Git Status

Display Git change statistics for directories in monorepo projects, directly in the Project View.

Features

  • ✅ Show colorful Git status next to directory names (~modified/+added/-deleted)
  • ✅ Auto-detect common monorepo structures (packages/*, apps/*, services/*)
  • ✅ Configurable directory monitoring
  • ✅ Real-time updates on VCS changes
  • ✅ Color-coded display: ~blue for modified, +red for added, -gray for deleted

Usage

  1. Install the plugin and restart your IDE
  2. Open a Git repository with a monorepo structure
  3. The plugin will auto-detect directories under packages/, apps/, services/
  4. Or manually configure directories in Settings → Tools → Monorepo Git Status
  5. Git status will appear next to configured directories in the Project View

Perfect for

  • Monorepo projects with multiple packages/services
  • Teams working on large codebases
  • Quick overview of changes across sub-projects
